title: Homebrew formula: 0.7.0 with the release's checksums. packaging/homebrew/wizardi
input: Homebrew formula: 0.7.0 with the release's checksums. packaging/homebrew/wizardingcode-mem.rb names version 0.7.0, the four release assets of v0.7.0 and their sha256 from the release's checksums.txt, so brew install wizardingcode-io/wizardingcode/wizardingcode-mem gets 0.7.0 once the tap carries the same file.
routeReasons: chore in one spot, clear request, no risk area

criteria.text: packaging/homebrew/wizardingcode-mem.rb has version 0.7.0, every url under releases/download/v0.7.0/, and for each of the four assets the sha256 that the release's checksums.txt publishes; checked by comparing the file with the checksums downloaded from the release.
